scripture.verse: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honor is humility.

sermons.title: Sermon 99 | The Duty of Remembering the Poor

scripture.verse: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

sermons.title: Sermon 100 | The Comer's Conflict with Satan

scripture.verse: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.
